Subject: Matrix reporting shift: proposed team & transition playbook

Team —

Following our leadership offsite, I put together a concrete proposal to move Engineering Platforms to a matrix reporting model for product-aligned squads. The intent: reduce individual manager spans, give product leads direct influence over day-to-day prioritization, and preserve a single technical manager for career growth & performance calibration.

High-level summary (attachments):
- org_chart_v2.pdf — proposed reporting lines and dotted lines to product leads
- transition_matrix.xlsx — role-by-role transition owner, expected SLA, and risk level
- comm-draft-affected-ic.docx — draft comms to impacted ICs (confidential)

Key asks:
1) HR: confirm comp band/grade alignment, potential promotion windows, any constraints on re-titling (Laura).
2) Leadership: sign-off on scope split between Platform Eng managers vs Product Eng leads (Markus, Aditya).
3) Timeline approval: proposed phased rollout over 6 weeks starting 10/4.
4) Confidentiality: please keep this thread restricted to recipients until we finalize the comms.

Why this approach now:
- Manager spans have increased to 1:14 across infra squads — negatively impacting 1:1 cadence and promotion readiness.
- Product roadmap requires faster cross-functional prioritization; current routing creates handoffs that add 3–5 days for urgent fixes.

Risks we've flagged in the matrix: temporary dips in throughput, need for updated performance review rubric for dotted-line work, and overlap in ownership for on-call rotations. Transition_matrix.xlsx has mitigations for each.

Proposed next steps: quick exec decision by 9/10, HR review by 9/14, leaders align on comm content by 9/17, rollout begins 10/4.

Please review and call out any blockers. I can walk through the slides today at 2pm if helpful.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Engineering Platforms
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Matrix reporting shift: proposed team & transition playbook

Mina — thanks for the thorough draft. A few quick points from my side: 

1) Headcount & manager load: the proposed split moves 6 ICs from my direct to dotted-line. I need clarity on who takes on the managerial responsibilities for coaching and PIPs while dotted-line relationships are established. Transition_matrix.xlsx lists "transition owners" but not interim coaching leads.

2) On-call / Pager duty: we must ensure SRE responsibilities are owned clearly by shipment teams during the transition week — can we add a hard owner column?

3) Timing: October 4 start is aggressive but doable if HR can clear regrades/promotions sooner. If not, we should delay by two weeks to avoid mid-cycle comp confusion.

I can join the 2pm walk-through and will prepare a short list of role-level asks.

-Markus

Mina / team — I reviewed the attachments. A few HR notes and requests before we sign off: 

• Comp bands and title changes: any change that alters scope/title needs a formal JD and a short case for band movement. Please populate the "JD_needed" column in transition_matrix.xlsx.

• Performance review alignment: the dotted-line work will complicate our Q4 calibration cycle. We need a one-page rubric describing how dotted-line contributions are evaluated and who owns the growth plan for promotions.

• Notice and confidentiality: recommend we use a two-phased comms plan — private 1:1s with affected ICs, then a team-level announcement 48–72 hours after. We should not send the comm-draft-affected-ic.docx outside this recipient list.

I'll block time with Lauren to align on process; can have HR comments back by 9/14. Also tagging Lauren for approval on change management steps.

Appreciate the framing, Mina. Two quick high-level decisions from my side: 

1) I support a phased approach but want a firm SLA for decision points (week 2 review to stop/continue the rollout). Put those review gates in the matrix and assign an exec sponsor for each gate (I can sponsor the week-2 checkpoint).

2) Communications: agree with private 1:1s first. Please produce a short script + FAQ for managers to use in those conversations. We cannot have surprises in the calibration cycle — Laura, please confirm the earliest date we can finalize promotion calendars if needed.

Also cc'ing external partner below (we engaged Summit Consulting for runbook support) — Hannah, if you can provide a lightweight runbook template for the 6-week rollout that maps owners to daily/weekly checkpoints, paste into the drive folder.

I'll be available for the 2pm review.

Hi all — quick note from Summit Consulting. We reviewed the matrix and have a short bundled playbook you can use. High-level: 

- Phase 0 (pre-comm): align JDs, freeze promotions for 3 business days before communications, confirm on-call owners.
- Phase 1 (week 1): manager 1:1s + role handoffs; daily standups between old/new owners; escalate blockers to the exec sponsor.
- Phase 2 (week 2–4): measurement window — throughput, incident response time, and morale survey.
- Phase 3 (week 5–6): consolidation and permanent assignment.

I attached a 6-page runbook (playbook_runbook_v1.pdf) to this message — it's a template, feel free to adapt. I'll add a checklist into your drive folder tonight.

Best,
Hannah Quinn
Partner, Summit Consulting
